The day of the Hanshin JF. Ikuno Dictus 
appears nervous as she takes in the tense 
GⅠ atmosphere. The Trainer tries their 
best to help ease her tension.

So, they decided to celebrate having made 
it to a GⅠ. Surprisingly, Ikuno Dictus got 
right into the spirit, cheering loudly 
with joy.

Just as the tension melted away, a call 
came in from Twin Turbo and the others. 
Heartened by her friends' cheers, Ikuno 
Dictus heads to the race with a smile.

The grand stage of a GⅠ. Even while 
feeling the electric tension in the air, 
Ikuno Dictus burns with fighting spirit.

The culmination of the Junior Class, the 
Hanshin JF, begins!
